# confvis

> Generate confidence badges and dashboards from aggregated code metrics. Transform JSON/YAML reports into SVG gauge badges and HTML dashboards.

## What It Does

confvis aggregates quality metrics from multiple sources (SonarQube, Codecov, Snyk, Trivy, GitHub Actions) into a single weighted confidence score, then visualizes it as badges or dashboards.

## GitHub Action Quick Start

```yaml
- uses: boinger/confvis@v1
  with:
    config: confidence.json
    output: badge.svg
```

## Input Schema

Confidence reports follow this structure:

```json
{
  "title": "Code Quality",
  "score": 85,
  "threshold": 80,
  "factors": [
    {"name": "Coverage", "score": 90, "weight": 50},
    {"name": "Security", "score": 80, "weight": 50}
  ]
}
```

- `score` is auto-calculated from weighted factors if omitted
- `threshold` determines pass/fail status on the badge
- `factors` break down contributing metrics

## Common Patterns

Threshold enforcement:
```yaml
- uses: boinger/confvis@v1
  with:
    config: confidence.json
    output: badge.svg
    fail-under: 75
```

Baseline comparison with regression detection:
```yaml
- uses: boinger/confvis@v1
  with:
    config: confidence.json
    output: badge.svg
    compare-baseline: true
    fail-on-regression: true
    save-baseline: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
```

PR comment with score:
```yaml
- uses: boinger/confvis@v1
  with:
    config: confidence.json
    output: badge.svg
    post-comment: true
```

Sparkline trend badge:
```yaml
- uses: boinger/confvis@v1
  with:
    config: confidence.json
    output: sparkline.svg
    badge-type: sparkline
    history-auto: true
```

## Action Inputs

| Input | Description | Default |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| config | Path to confidence report (JSON/YAML) | required |
| output | Output path for badge/report | required |
| command | gauge, generate, or aggregate | gauge |
| format | svg, json, text, markdown, github-comment | svg |
| badge-type | gauge, flat, or sparkline | gauge |
| style | github, minimal, corporate, high-contrast | github |
| dark | Use dark mode colors | false |
| fail-under | Fail if score below threshold | 0 |
| compare-baseline | Compare against stored baseline | false |
| fail-on-regression | Fail if score decreased | false |
| save-baseline | Save current score as baseline | false |
| create-check | Create GitHub Check Run | false |
| post-comment | Post PR comment with report | false |
| history-auto | Auto-manage sparkline history | false |

## Action Outputs

| Output | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| score | Confidence score (0-100) |
| passed | Whether score met threshold |
| delta | Change from baseline |
